messages:
marie-eng: deploy-bot just threw a late-window alert for model-routing (route: text-gen, version: 5.2.1). Canary p95 jumped ~30% and error-rate ~1.9% over baseline. deploy-bot recommends AUTO_REVERT. thoughts? @lee-oncall @sam-sre

deploy-bot: ALERT -> AUTOREVERT_RECOMMENDATION. Criteria met: p95 > 200ms for 4m and errors >1.5% for 3m. Canary slice=10%. Options: AUTOREVERT or HUMAN_ROLLBACK.

sam-sre: Can we confirm this is not a metrics blip? grab raw traces and region split pls.

ops-bot: telemetry snapshot: region=us-east-1 (70% of canary), p95_eus=180ms, p95_us=235ms, error_rate=1.9%. No deploy infra anomalies. logs show increased RPC time on runtime-gpu-12 in us-east-1.

toni-prod: We have a handful of enterprise customers on this route. If we autopilot revert it'll be quick but noisy. Manual rollback gives us time to pin dedicated pools. Recommend manual rollback and suppress autopilot for this release.

lee-oncall: Taking responsibility. Manual rollback preferred. Sam, can you run rollback playbook? I'll coordinate release-note and customer comms.

sam-sre: Will do. Plan: 1) freeze rollout traffic, 2) set release pin to text-gen:5.2.0, 3) run /playbooks/manual-rollback-textgen, 4) monitor 15m. Also set deploy-bot:autopilot_disabled=true.

marie-eng: Commands I'm going to run with you:
```
deployctl traffic freeze --release text-gen:5.2.1 --slice canary
deployctl pin --service text-gen --version 5.2.0 --reason "rollback: latency/error regression"
# disable auto revert
deployctl annotate --release text-gen:5.2.1 autopilot_disabled=true
```

ops-bot: checklist posted: [freeze applied] [pin applied] [autopilot disabled] [runbook started]. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/playbooks/manual-rollback-textgen

nina-pm: I'll prepare a short customer note. Also flagging product for a brief internal post with impact estimate.

sam-sre: freeze applied -> done. pin applied -> done. autopilot flag set -> done. kicking rollback job id rb-49432 now.

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual rollback initiated by sam-sre. Autopilot suppressed by flag.

sam-sre: rollback progress: draining new replicas, routing back to 5.2.0, healthchecks passing on 80% replicas. Observed p95_us drop to 150ms after 2m, errors down to 0.4%. Monitoring continues.

lee-oncall: Good. I'll draft internal summary and start a follow-up ticket for eng-runtime and eng-ml to triage. Marie, update release notes to reflect rollback. Nina, hold on external comms until ops gives green.

marie-eng: Release notes updated: "Rolled back text-gen v5.2.1 to v5.2.0 due to latency and error increases observed in canary during late change window. Investigation underway." Pinned metadata set for 24h.

nina-pm: Customer note ready in #customer-comms draft. Short, includes apology and ETA for further details.

sam-sre: 15m monitor complete. Stability restored across regions. Closing rollback rb-49432.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2024-49432 assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml for RCA. Tags: latency, error-spike, runtime-gpu-12, canary

toni-prod: I'll notify dedicated pool owners to keep pin until we confirm RCA. Also scheduling a follow-up sync with affected accounts.

lee-oncall: Thanks team. Action items: eng-runtime to reproduce on gpu-12, eng-ml to check model perf diffs between 5.2.0 and 5.2.1, product to coordinate customer comms. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
